systems.country_label: A three-year MoU between the regulator and the chamber of commerce, with a joint steering committee over its own implementation; no named law or policy consulted on

note: MoU on PKI, cybersecurity and legislative reform among other areas; no named digital law or policy put to people outside government, and the steering committee oversees the MoU, not a law.
